IS:6763(Part 2)-19B7 



Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION AND TESTING FOR 
FIFTH WHEEL KING PIN FOR SEMI-TRAILERS 

PART 2 SIZE 90 

( First Revision ) 



(Reaffirmed 2002) 



1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions and testing procedures for the size 90 ( <^39 mm ) fifth wheel 
king pin which is used for coupling extra heavy-duty vehicles. In addition, this standard specifies the 
dimensional characteristics necessary for mounting and interchangeability. ^ 

2. Terminology 

2.1 For the purpose of this standard, the definitions given in IS : 7774-1975 'Glossary of terms relat- 
ing to transport tractors and trailers: Part 1 Basic terms, and Part 2 Dimensions and weight', shall 
apply.

4. Material — The material for fifth wheel king pin shall be such as to withstand the drawbar pull 
test as specified in 5.1. Some of the suitable materials are given in Appendix A for information. 



5. Tests 

5.0 The following tests shall be carried out on fifth wheel king pin used for coupling extra heavy- 
duty vehicles. 

5.1 Drawbar Pull Test— l\\e king pin shall be subjected to a drawbar pull of 550 kN load by applying 
the load at any point of 89 mm diameter surface. The pin shall withstand the test satisfactorily 
without any residual deformation to itself. 

5.2 C/7ec/://7flr i7//r/V75r P//7— In order to check king pin assembled to the trailer rubbing plate on 
longitudinal and transverse centre lines, place the top of the gauge in contact with the rubbing 
plate and slide over the king pin. The king pin shall pass through the king pin slot with the top of 
the gauge in contact with the rubbing plate. 



IS: 6763 (Part 2). 1987 

APPENDIX A 

( Clause 4 ) 

MATERIALS FOR SIZE 90 FIFTH WHEEL KING PIN 

A-1. The fifth wheel king pins for semi-traiJer and trailer are normally made from high tensile 
chromium molybdenum steels. Some of the suitable steels for this purpose are given below: 

Steel Designation Relevant Indian Standard 

40Cr4M03 IS : 5517-1978 'Specification for steels for 

hardening and tempering ( //Vs^ revision)' 

15Cr13M06 do 

25 Crl3M06 do 



EXPL A NATORY NOTE 

Fifth wheel king pin is used for coupling semi-trailers with the fifth wheel of a prime mover or 
a load dividing dolly attached to the prime mover. 

This standard was first published in 1976. This revision includes the dimensions of the check 
gauge. In this revision, the dimensional characteristics necessary for mounting and interchange- 
ability have also been included. 

This standard is being issued in the following two parts: 

Part 1 Size 50, and 

Part 2 Size 90. 

In the preparation of this Standard, the assistance has been derived from ISO 4084-1982 
'Road vehicles — 90 semi-trailers fifth wheel king pin — Basic and mounting/interchangeability 
dimensions', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO f.
